question_text: Across all crowd-mode cameras (ExpoFloor_MainAisle, DemoBooth_NVIDIA, DemoBooth_Intel, KeynoteHall_Stage, FoodCourt_North) on 2025-12-08 (UTC), which location showed the most extreme peak-to-baseline contrast — meaning the largest ratio of its peak head_count to its overnight quiet-hour average head_count? Identify the camera_location and explain the ratio order of magnitude.
answer_text: The location with the most extreme peak-to-baseline contrast on 2025-12-08 (UTC) was "KeynoteHall_Stage," with a peak head count of 500 and an average overnight quiet-hour head count of approximately 57.40. This results in a peak-to-baseline ratio of about 8.71, indicating that the peak head count was over 8 times the baseline average.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c:Camera)
WHERE c.camera_location IN ['ExpoFloor_MainAisle', 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA', 'DemoBooth_Intel', 'KeynoteHall_Stage', 'FoodCourt_North']
  AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH c.camera_location AS location, ch.peak_hc AS peak_hc, ch.avg_hc AS avg_hc, ch.hour_utc AS hour_utc
ORDER BY hour_utc
WITH location, MAX(peak_hc) AS max_peak_hc, AVG(avg_hc) AS avg_baseline_hc
RETURN location, max_peak_hc, avg_baseline_hc, max_peak_hc / avg_baseline_hc AS peak_to_baseline_ratio
ORDER BY peak_to_baseline_ratio DESC
LIMIT 1
